shortDescription: Resolve shift and overtime eligibility from frozen work rules and attested evidence, with capped deterministic minute calculations.
detailedDescription: ShiftFair is a full GenLayer application for shift changes and overtime claims. Parties freeze a written work rule, lock evidence and nominate a distinct attestor. The app reads canonical claim pages and history, and supports participation, adjudication, challenges and finalization. Requested and approved minutes remain bounded by immutable policy parameters.
problemSolved: Shift decisions mix natural-language work rules, supervisor authorization, attendance evidence and capped overtime arithmetic.
whyGenLayer: Independent semantic validators assess authorization, attendance and evidence sufficiency against frozen text. Deterministic arithmetic then computes eligible minutes; an ordinary workflow cannot credibly perform both tasks.
semanticConsensus: Leader and validators independently classify supervisor_authorized, attendance_matches_shift and evidence_sufficient inside GenLayer nondeterministic execution. The response schema is exact. The contract caps requested/policy minutes and derives provisional/final results deterministically; disagreement cannot become approval.
reviewInstructions: Inspect production URL in read-only mode, the deployed contract, and evidence/shiftfair-live.json for GLV4-shiftfair-39138804500. The terminal verdict is REVIEW_REQUIRED. The public app remains RELEASE_QUALIFIED=false pending signed-browser qualification and redeployment.
knownLimitations: Attestor wallet control does not independently authenticate employee, supervisor, payroll identity or real attendance; the contract does not pay wages. Qualification source data were synthetic. The updated repository frontend has not been deployed to the public URL.
